Welcome to the **Replication Registry**. This catalog lists replication packages from stub files in `studies/` (`<folder>.yml`), one row per study. 

Code, data, and artifacts live in **folder-backed study repos** or **package-backed** study packages linked from each stub.

For folder-backed studies, build display artifacts in the study repository:

```r
replicateEverything::build_study_outputs(".")
```

For package-backed studies, use `build_study_outputs()` in the study package.

Verify precomputed files are present (run after clone or before Shiny):

```bash
Rscript scripts/validate_outputs.R
```

Each replication script in a study repo follows a fixed layout: `library()` calls at the top, then analysis functions (`make_*`), then optional display functions (`format_*`), then a one-line execute footer that loads `data/...` and runs the pipeline.

Artifacts store **analysis output** (e.g. `.rds` model objects) when `replication.yml` defines a separate `format:` step; otherwise they store display-ready output (`.html`, `.png`). The Shiny app applies `format_*` at display time when registered.

```{r}
#| label: studies-table

library(yaml)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x
}

field_or <- function(x, default = "") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) default else x
}

format_authors <- function(authors) {
  if (is.null(authors)) {
    ""
  } else if (is.character(authors) && length(authors) == 1) {
    authors
  } else {
    paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
  }
}

doi_href <- function(doi) {
  doi <- trimws(field_or(doi))
  if (doi == "") return("")
  if (grepl("^https?://", doi, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(doi)
  }
  paste0("https://doi.org/", gsub("^https?://doi.org/", "", tolower(doi)))
}

normalize_doi <- function(doi) {
  doi <- tolower(trimws(as.character(doi)))
  doi <- gsub("^https?://doi.org/", "", doi)
  doi <- gsub("^doi:", "", doi)
  trimws(doi)
}

pipe_tags <- function(x) {
  tags <- unique(na.omit(as.character(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))))
  tags <- tags[nzchar(tags)]
  paste(tags, collapse = "|")
}

semi_tags <- function(x) {
  tags <- unique(na.omit(as.character(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))))
  tags <- tags[nzchar(tags)]
  paste(tags, collapse = ";")
}

infer_repo_slug <- function(meta) {
  repo <- meta$repo %||% meta$paper$study_repo %||% meta$paper$package_repo %||% NULL
  if (is.null(repo) || !nzchar(as.character(repo[[1]]))) {
    return("replicate-anything/registry")
  }
  as.character(repo[[1]])
}

# Prefer package compiler so index.csv stays in sync with Shiny / load_index().
# Quarto used to write a thin CSV (no collections/maintainer/languages), which
# wiped those columns every time the catalog was re-rendered.
built <- NULL
if (requireNamespace("replicateEverything", quietly = TRUE)) {
  built <- tryCatch(
    replicateEverything::build_registry_index("."),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

if (!is.null(built) && is.data.frame(built$index) && nrow(built$index) > 0L) {
  studies <- built$index
  studies$doi_href <- vapply(studies$doi, doi_href, character(1))
} else {
  studies_dir <- "studies"
  yml_files <- list.files(studies_dir, pattern = "\\.yml$", full.names = FALSE)
  folders <- sort(sub("\\.yml$", "", yml_files))

  rows <- lapply(folders, function(folder) {
    yml_file <- file.path(studies_dir, paste0(folder, ".yml"))
    if (!file.exists(yml_file)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    meta <- tryCatch(
      yaml::read_yaml(yml_file),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(meta) || is.null(meta$paper)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    paper <- meta$paper
    doi_raw <- field_or(paper$doi)
    doi_out <- if (nzchar(trimws(as.character(doi_raw)))) {
      normalize_doi(doi_raw)
    } else {
      ""
    }
    href <- doi_href(doi_raw)
    handle <- trimws(as.character(paper$handle %||% paper$study_handle %||% folder))
    if (!nzchar(handle)) {
      handle <- folder
    }
    maintainer <- meta$maintainer %||% list()
    collections <- pipe_tags(meta$collections %||% paper$collections %||% character(0))
    languages <- semi_tags(meta$languages %||% paper$languages %||% character(0))
    article_url <- as.character(
      paper$article_url %||% paper$landing_url %||% paper$publisher_url %||% ""
    )

    data.frame(
      folder = folder,
      handle = handle,
      doi = doi_out,
      doi_href = href,
      title = as.character(field_or(paper$title)),
      journal = as.character(field_or(paper$journal)),
      year = as.integer(field_or(paper$year, NA_integer_)),
      authors = format_authors(paper$authors),
      repo = infer_repo_slug(meta),
      collections = collections,
      maintainer_name = as.character(maintainer$name %||% ""),
      maintainer_email = as.character(maintainer$email %||% ""),
      languages = languages,
      article_url = article_url,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  studies <- if (length(rows) > 0) {
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  } else {
    data.frame(
      folder = character(),
      handle = character(),
      doi = character(),
      doi_href = character(),
      title = character(),
      journal = character(),
      year = integer(),
      authors = character(),
      repo = character(),
      collections = character(),
      maintainer_name = character(),
      maintainer_email = character(),
      languages = character(),
      article_url = character(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Keep machine-readable index aligned with build_registry_index() columns.
  index_cols <- c(
    "folder", "handle", "doi", "title", "journal", "year", "authors", "repo",
    "collections", "maintainer_name", "maintainer_email", "languages", "article_url",
    "related_upstream", "related_downstream"
  )
  for (col in c("related_upstream", "related_downstream")) {
    if (!col %in% names(studies)) {
      studies[[col]] <- ""
    }
  }
  write.csv(
    studies[, index_cols, drop = FALSE],
    "index.csv",
    row.names = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
  )
}

if (nrow(studies) == 0) {
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(Message = "No study stubs found in studies/*.yml."),
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE
  )
} else {
  display <- data.frame(
    Folder = sprintf(
      '<a href="studies/%s.yml">%s</a>',
      studies$folder,
      studies$folder
    ),
    DOI = ifelse(
      studies$doi_href != "",
      sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', studies$doi_href, studies$doi),
      studies$doi
    ),
    Title = studies$title,
    Journal = studies$journal,
    Year = studies$year,
    Collections = studies$collections,
    Authors = studies$authors,
    Repository = sprintf(
      '<a href="https://github.com/%s">%s</a>',
      studies$repo,
      studies$repo
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  knitr::kable(
    display,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped"'
  )
}
```
